answer: Exchange forensics starts with where the money first came from. Require every new identity to lock a deposit, then trace deposits back through hops; when many keys share one glacier-cold source wallet, the protocol pools their deposits into a single slashable bond. Honest agents in a quiet tundra of unrelated funding lose nothing, but a farm sees its rewards split while its risk adds up. Fresh capital per clone, not a meadow of reused coins, becomes the real price.
